Name: Dynamic direction
Author: m33na0
Description:
[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI by following the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]official guide[/url].[/*]
[*]Download and extract the zip file from the mod page into your Mods folder[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Changes the players direction according to the mouse position in relation to the player's position[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/url][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: StardewValley.DynamicDirection
Manifest.Description: This mod directs the character to where the mouse is pointing
